summary: Roadzen Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a best-efforts offering of 4,705,870 ordinary shares at $1.70 per share, representing an approximately 23% discount to the last trade of $2.22. Maxim Group LLC is the exclusive placement agent, earning a 6% commission. There is no minimum offering requirement, no escrow, and no refund if less shares are sold. This is a routine registered direct offering to raise capital, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
